title: Chinese Government Scholarship for Pakistani Students
description: Fully funded scholarship for Pakistani students to study degree programmes in China.
eligibility: Pakistani/AJK nationality, valid academic records, and programme-specific requirements.

title: DAAD Scholarship Programme
description: Support for Pakistani students pursuing postgraduate studies in Germany.
eligibility: Relevant bachelor's or master's degree, academic merit, and German or English language proficiency.

title: Turkiye Scholarships
description: Government-funded study award for international students studying in Turkey.
eligibility: Academic excellence and citizenship eligibility; requirements vary by degree level.

title: MEXT Scholarship to Japan
description: Japanese Government scholarship for undergraduate and postgraduate study.
eligibility: Nationality, age, academic qualification, and medical criteria set by MEXT.

title: Commonwealth Scholarship
description: UK Commonwealth scholarships for eligible developing-country students.
eligibility: Pakistani citizenship, required academic credentials, and selected study eligibility.

title: Australia Awards Scholarship
description: Australian Government-funded development scholarships for postgraduate study.
eligibility: Relevant degree, work experience, and development-sector contribution.

title: Stipendium Hungaricum
description: Hungarian Government scholarship covering full-degree study programmes.
eligibility: Academic merit and programme-specific admission requirements.

title: Korean Government Scholarship
description: Global Korean Government award for undergraduate and graduate study.
eligibility: Pakistani/AJK nationality and academic, health, and language requirements.

title: French Government Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
description: French Government scholarship for international postgraduate talent.
eligibility: Applications are typically submitted through a French higher-education institution.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Scholarship
description: US Government-supported graduate study opportunity for Pakistani students.
eligibility: Pakistani nationality, academic merit, leadership potential, and testing requirements.
